metadata.title: QuranGraph Numbers Lab
metadata.description: Reproducible, transparent Quranic statistics with explicit counting rules.

surah_metrics.name_en: She that is to be examined

audited_claims.rule: Counts all singular noun occurrences of 'shahr' (including definite 'al-shahr' and prefixed forms), excluding the dual (shahrayn, 2) and plural forms (ashhur, shuhur, 7).
audited_claims.scholar_note: A mathematically exact correspondence to the 12 lunar months of the Islamic calendar, in accordance with Surah 9:36: 'Indeed, the number of months with Allah is twelve months in the register of Allah'.

audited_claims.title_bn: দুনিয়া ও আখিরাত শব্দের সমান পুনরাবৃত্তি (১১৫ ও ১১৫)
audited_claims.rule: Exact lemma count of 'dunya' (115) versus exact noun tokens of the root 'أ-خ-ر' referring to the Afterlife 'al-Akhirah' (115).
audited_claims.scholar_note: A striking lexical balance where this temporal world (dunya) and the eternal afterlife (akhirah) appear exactly 115 times each throughout the Quran.

audited_claims.title_bn: কুরআনে 'দিন' (ইয়াওম) শব্দের ৩৬৫ বার আগমন বিষয়ক দাবি
audited_claims.rule: Root 'y-w-m' occurs 475 times in total. To reach 365, one must selectively exclude plural forms (ayyam, 27), dual forms (yawmayn, 3), and adverbial temporal constructions (yawma'idhin, 80).
audited_claims.scholar_note: Scholars such as Dr. Ashraf Bilal note that while the count of 365 can be reached by counting only singular non-adverbial occurrences, it requires specific exclusion criteria. Readers should understand the exact rule applied.

audited_claims.title_bn: ফেরেশতা ও শয়তান শব্দের অনুপাত (৮৮ ও ৮৮)
audited_claims.rule: Root 'sh-t-n' (devils/shaytan) occurs 88 times. The noun occurrences for 'angel/mala'ikah' from root 'm-l-k' reach 88 when verbal and dominion forms (malakat, malakut) are separated.
audited_claims.scholar_note: Both words appear across 88 instances under standard morphological filtering, symbolizing the perpetual spiritual balance between guidance and temptation.

audited_claims.title_en: Ratio of Sea (Bahr) to Land (Barr) matching Earth's Surface
audited_claims.title_bn: সাগর (বাহর) ও স্থলভাগ (বারর)-এর অনুপাত ও পৃথিবীর ভূমিরূপ
audited_claims.rule: Root 'b-h-r' (sea/water) occurs 41 times (32 referring specifically to large bodies of water); root 'b-r-r' occurs 12 or 13 times as the noun for dry land. 32 / (32 + 13) = 71.1%, close to earth's ~71% water surface.
audited_claims.scholar_note: A popular observation popularized in modern lectures. While the arithmetic proportion is intriguing, classical mufassirun emphasize the direct spiritual meaning of each verse rather than speculative geographic percentages.

audited_claims.status: Disputed and Rejected by Mainstream Scholars
audited_claims.rule: Based on Surah 74:30 ('Over it are nineteen'). Rashad Khalifa claimed all Quranic structures are multiples of 19, but this required deleting the final two verses of Surah at-Tawbah (9:128-129) when they contradicted his calculations.
audited_claims.scholar_note: Mainstream Islamic scholars unanimously reject this theory. Altering or deleting any ayah of the Holy Quran is kufr and violates the preservation of the divine text guaranteed in Surah 15:9.
